text: Hey! I'm Pingo, and I'm your learning companion.
Stuck on a lesson with no one to explain it? Come with me, I'll show you Athena!
This is Athena! I teach in Arabic, Darija, French or English.
Joining takes seconds: pick a username, a nickname and a password.
Next, a quick quiz, and my AI figures out how you learn best.
Ask me anything! Pick how I teach, and every question earns you ten XP.
In your garden, every goal is a plant. Master it, and it blooms for fifty XP!
Level up, and my olive sprig grows into a crown!
Hackathons! My AI writes your brief and your challenge. Ask me in Team Chat, then compete together!
So, what are you waiting for? Your next level is waiting! Join me on Athena!
